decision.reason: [ev-eb9884e0aaab] only says istioctl added support for "the impersonate flags used in kube client". It does not name any flag, so "--as" is not in the evidence. "--as (impersonate flags)" is also not a valid flag name: it adds a parenthetical gloss to the name. The change type "added" fits the text, but a cli-flag subject cannot be spelled correctly without the actual flag names. That would need the PR, the istioctl CLI reference or a CLI diff, and the render-based validators were inconclusive.
